Section headers

An optional <header> above a <lay-out> grid, wrapped in a <lay-out-group>. The header lives inside the (optionally themed / full-bleed) box but outside the grid — so the grid engine is untouched and this works over every layout pattern. The header parts reuse the data-part vocabulary.
